mapper.sql: NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_block b WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND ( (b.blocker_user_no = ${ownerExpr} AND b.blocked_user_no = ${actorExpr}) OR (b.blocker_user_no = ${actorExpr} AND b.blocked_user_no = ${ownerExpr}) ) )

n.receiver_user_no = #{userNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user actor WHERE actor.user_no = n.actor_user_no AND actor.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' ) AND ( n.feed_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_feed f WHERE f.feed_id = n.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 ) ) AND ( n.story_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_story s WHERE s.story_id = n.story_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 ) ) AND (n.type <> 'NEIGHBOR_REQUEST' OR n.neighbor_id IS NOT NULL) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_notification_setting s WHERE s.user_no = n.receiver_user_no ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_notification_setting s WHERE s.user_no = n.receiver_user_no AND ( (n.type = 'NEIGHBOR_REQUEST' AND s.neighbor = 1) OR (n.type = 'FEED_LIKE' AND s.like_post = 1) OR (n.type = 'COMMENT_LIKE' AND s.like_comment = 1) OR (n.type = 'REPLY_LIKE' AND s.like_reply = 1) OR (n.type = 'FEED_COMMENT' AND ( (n.has_comment = 1 AND s.comment_on_post = 1) OR (n.has_reply = 1 AND s.reply_on_comment = 1) )) OR (n.type IN ('COMMENT_MENTION', 'REPLY_MENTION') AND s.mention = 1) OR (n.type = 'FEED_TAG' AND s.tag_post = 1) OR (n.type = 'STORY_TAG' AND s.tag_story = 1) OR (n.type = 'STORY_LIKE' AND s.story_react = 1) ) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_notification ( receiver_user_no, actor_user_no, type, feed_id, feed_comment_id, feed_reply_id, story_id, neighbor_id, content, actor_count, has_comment, has_reply, group_key, is_read, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverUserNo}, #{actorUserNo}, #{type}, #{feedId}, #{feedCommentId}, #{feedReplyId}, #{storyId}, #{neighborId}, #{content}, #{actorCount}, #{hasComment}, #{hasReply}, #{groupKey}, 0, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actor_user_no = VALUES(actor_user_no), feed_id = VALUES(feed_id), feed_comment_id = VALUES(feed_comment_id), feed_reply_id = VALUES(feed_reply_id), story_id = VALUES(story_id), neighbor_id = VALUES(neighbor_id), content = VALUES(content), actor_count = VALUES(actor_count), has_comment = VALUES(has_comment), has_reply = VALUES(has_reply), is_read = IF(#{markUnread} = 1, 0, is_read), read_at = IF(#{markUnread} = 1, NULL, read_at), updated_at = IF(#{markUnread} = 1, NOW(), updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT f.user_no AS receiver_user_no, ( SELECT l.user_no FROM ultary_feed_like l WHERE l.feed_id = f.feed_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> f.user_no AND ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.feed_like_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS actor_user_no, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_no) FROM ultary_feed_like l WHERE l.feed_id = f.feed_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> f.user_no AND ) AS actor_count, f.content AS content, f.feed_id AS feed_id FROM ultary_feed f WHERE f.feed_id = #{feedId} AND f.is_deleted = 0

SELECT c.user_no AS receiver_user_no, ( SELECT l.user_no FROM ultary_feed_comment_like l WHERE l.feed_comment_id = c.feed_comment_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> c.user_no AND ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.feed_comment_like_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS actor_user_no, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_no) FROM ultary_feed_comment_like l WHERE l.feed_comment_id = c.feed_comment_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> c.user_no AND ) AS actor_count, c.content AS content, c.feed_id AS feed_id, c.feed_comment_id AS feed_comment_id FROM ultary_feed_comment c INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.feed_comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.user_no AS receiver_user_no, ( SELECT l.user_no FROM ultary_feed_reply_like l WHERE l.feed_reply_id = r.feed_reply_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> r.user_no AND ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.feed_reply_like_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS actor_user_no, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_no) FROM ultary_feed_reply_like l WHERE l.feed_reply_id = r.feed_reply_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> r.user_no AND ) AS actor_count, r.content AS content, c.feed_id AS feed_id, c.feed_comment_id AS feed_comment_id, r.feed_reply_id AS feed_reply_id FROM ultary_feed_reply r INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = r.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.feed_reply_id = #{replyId} AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT f.user_no AS receiver_user_no, latest.user_no AS actor_user_no, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.user_no) FROM ( SELECT c.user_no FROM ultary_feed_comment c WHERE c.feed_id = f.feed_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.user_no <> f.user_no AND UNION SELECT r.user_no FROM ultary_feed_reply r INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = r.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.feed_id = f.feed_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.user_no <> f.user_no AND ) x ) AS actor_count, latest.content AS content, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_feed_comment c WHERE c.feed_id = f.feed_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.user_no <> f.user_no AND ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_comment, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_feed_reply r INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = r.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.feed_id = f.feed_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.user_no <> f.user_no AND ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_reply, f.feed_id AS feed_id, latest.feed_comment_id AS feed_comment_id, latest.feed_reply_id AS feed_reply_id FROM ultary_feed f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.feed_id, e.user_no, e.content, e.feed_comment_id, e.feed_reply_id FROM ( SELECT c.feed_id, c.user_no, c.content, c.feed_comment_id, NULL AS feed_reply_id, c.created_at, c.feed_comment_id AS sort_id FROM ultary_feed_comment c INNER JOIN ultary_feed owner_feed ON owner_feed.feed_id = c.feed_id WHERE c.feed_id = #{feedId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.user_no <> owner_feed.user_no AND UNION ALL SELECT c.feed_id, r.user_no, r.content, c.feed_comment_id, r.feed_reply_id, r.created_at, r.feed_reply_id AS sort_id FROM ultary_feed_reply r INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = r.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_feed owner_feed ON owner_feed.feed_id = c.feed_id WHERE c.feed_id = #{feedId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.user_no <> owner_feed.user_no AND ) e ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.sort_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON latest.feed_id = f.feed_id WHERE f.feed_id = #{feedId} AND f.is_deleted = 0

SELECT c.user_no AS actor_user_no, c.content AS content, c.feed_id AS feed_id, c.feed_comment_id AS feed_comment_id FROM ultary_feed_comment c INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.feed_comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.user_no AS actor_user_no, r.content AS content, c.feed_id AS feed_id, c.feed_comment_id AS feed_comment_id, r.feed_reply_id AS feed_reply_id FROM ultary_feed_reply r INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = r.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.feed_reply_id = #{replyId} AND r.is_deleted = 0
SELECT f.user_no AS actor_user_no, f.content AS content, f.feed_id AS feed_id FROM ultary_feed f WHERE f.feed_id = #{feedId} AND f.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.user_no AS actor_user_no, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(s.caption), ''), ( SELECT t.content FROM ultary_story_text t WHERE t.story_id = s.story_id ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, t.story_text_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS content, s.story_id AS story_id FROM ultary_story s WHERE s.story_id = #{storyId} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.user_no AS receiver_user_no, ( SELECT l.user_no FROM ultary_story_like l WHERE l.story_id = s.story_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> s.user_no AND ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.story_like_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS actor_user_no, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_no) FROM ultary_story_like l WHERE l.story_id = s.story_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.user_no <> s.user_no AND ) AS actor_count, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(s.caption), ''), ( SELECT t.content FROM ultary_story_text t WHERE t.story_id = s.story_id ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, t.story_text_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS content, s.story_id AS story_id FROM ultary_story s WHERE s.story_id = #{storyId} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT n.receiver_user_no AS receiver_user_no, n.requester_user_no AS actor_user_no, 1 AS actor_count, n.neighbor_id AS neighbor_id FROM ultary_neighbor n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.requester_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE n.neighbor_id = #{neighborId} AND n.status = 'PENDING'

SELECT DISTINCT p.user_no FROM ( SELECT mm.pet_id FROM ultary_feed_media_mention mm INNER JOIN ultary_feed_media m ON m.feed_media_id = mm.feed_media_id WHERE m.feed_id = #{feedId} UNION SELECT fp.pet_id FROM ultary_feed_pet fp WHERE fp.feed_id = #{feedId} ) tagged INNER JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = tagged.pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = p.user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = #{feedId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.user_no <> f.user_no AND

SELECT DISTINCT p.user_no FROM ultary_story_mention sm INNER JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = sm.pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = p.user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN ultary_story s ON s.story_id = sm.story_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sm.story_id = #{storyId} AND p.user_no <> s.user_no AND

SELECT DISTINCT t.receiver_user_no FROM ( SELECT m.mentioned_user_no AS receiver_user_no FROM ultary_feed_comment_mention m WHERE m.feed_comment_id = #{commentId} AND m.mentioned_user_no IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT p.user_no FROM ultary_feed_comment_mention m INNER JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = m.mentioned_pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.feed_comment_id = #{commentId} AND m.mentioned_pet_id IS NOT NULL ) t INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = t.receiver_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.receiver_user_no <> c.user_no AND

SELECT DISTINCT t.receiver_user_no FROM ( SELECT m.mentioned_user_no AS receiver_user_no FROM ultary_feed_comment_mention m WHERE m.feed_reply_id = #{replyId} AND m.mentioned_user_no IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT p.user_no FROM ultary_feed_comment_mention m INNER JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = m.mentioned_pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.feed_reply_id = #{replyId} AND m.mentioned_pet_id IS NOT NULL ) t INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = t.receiver_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN ultary_feed_reply r ON r.feed_reply_id = #{replyId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.receiver_user_no <> r.user_no AND

SELECT n.notification_id, n.type, n.actor_user_no, u.nickname AS actor_nickname, n.actor_count, CASE WHEN n.type = 'FEED_COMMENT' AND IFNULL(s.comment_on_post, 1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n.has_comment END AS has_comment, CASE WHEN n.type = 'FEED_COMMENT' AND IFNULL(s.reply_on_comment, 1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n.has_reply END AS has_reply, n.content, n.feed_id, n.feed_comment_id, n.feed_reply_id, n.story_id, n.neighbor_id, nb.status AS neighbor_status, n.is_read, n.updated_at FROM ultary_notification n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.actor_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ultary_neighbor nb ON nb.neighbor_id = n.neighbor_id LEFT JOIN ultary_notification_setting s ON s.user_no = n.receiver_user_no WHERE ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC, n.notification_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_notification n WHERE AND n.is_read = 0

SELECT n.notification_id, n.type, n.actor_user_no, u.nickname AS actor_nickname, n.actor_count, CASE WHEN n.type = 'FEED_COMMENT' AND IFNULL(s.comment_on_post, 1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n.has_comment END AS has_comment, CASE WHEN n.type = 'FEED_COMMENT' AND IFNULL(s.reply_on_comment, 1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE n.has_reply END AS has_reply, n.content, n.feed_id, n.feed_comment_id, n.feed_reply_id, n.story_id, n.neighbor_id, nb.status AS neighbor_status, n.is_read, n.updated_at FROM ultary_notification n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.actor_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ultary_neighbor nb ON nb.neighbor_id = n.neighbor_id LEFT JOIN ultary_notification_setting s ON s.user_no = n.receiver_user_no WHERE n.notification_id = #{notificationId} AND
